Subject: Compact kiosk accessibility routing & stacked demo kiosk plan

Hi all,

Attaching the latest floorplan (floorplan_v3.pdf) and a proposed stacking diagram for the 6'x3' compact kiosks (stacking_diagram.png). Main asks to confirm before I lock these in with venue ops and print: 

- ADA clearance: show of hands if the 36" clear walkway at the front of Pod C2 is acceptable once we stack two kiosks end-to-end (we'll be +12" from the backwall). Venue has flagged the side aisle as a pinch point.
- Power & AV: preferred is single 20A run per podium with in-line splitter at the riser. If that won't pass inspection, tell me alternatives.
- Crate size + pick-up cutoff: Expo requires crate dims by 11/12 for early freight; confirm vendor crate dims so we can order the riser plates and dolly/escort.
- Signage mounting: BrightPrints — can you confirm laminate thickness for pop-out headers? We may need 1/8" Kapton spacers for the stacking seam.

Schedule: final floorplan sign-off by EOD 11/05 so printing and crate labels can be produced on Monday.

Attachments: floorplan_v3.pdf (layout), stacking_diagram.png (stack height + sightline), kiosk_specs.xlsx (requested by BrightPrints)

Thanks — Priya

From: BrightPrints Co. <hello@brightprints.co>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 13:45:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Compact kiosk accessibility routing & stacked demo kiosk plan

Hi Priya — thanks for the drawings. Quick responses inline: 

- ADA clearance: we can maintain the 36" front path but stacking two units end-to-end reduces the lateral sightline for a 36" path by ~4" if headers extend. Recommend we drop header depth by 1/2" at the stacked seam.
- Mounting/layering: we can ship panels with 1/8" foam tape pre-applied; if you want Kapton, we can do that too but it adds a 48-hour lead time.
- Print tolerances: our laminate tolerances are +/- 0.06"; we suggest we cut panels to interleave and avoid any visible seam sag.

Attached: kiosk_specs.xlsx (includes proposed bolt patterns and a note on max stacking height = 72" with weighted base). 

We will hold a soft print hold until we get final confirmation of the walkway and power plan. If you want, we can mock up a 1:10 scale sightline model to confirm visual blocking (extra cost).

Regards,
Clara Mendoza
Account Director — BrightPrints Co.

Thanks everyone — decision summary and next steps: 

1) Stacking approach: Go ahead with stacked kiosks but drop header depth by 1/2" at the seam. BrightPrints to proceed with Kapton option and expedite (Clara — please confirm 48-hour delta).
2) ADA clearance & sightlines: Confirmed acceptable by venue as long as the front path is kept at 36" min. DesignHouse to mark the path on the install sheet.
3) Power & AV: Logan to confirm spare 20A riser availability. If inventory unavailable, Priya to approve Expo Ops rental up to $450.
4) Crates & freight: DesignHouse — please send final crate dims by COB Monday 11/08. We will send the DocuSign crate-handling addendum to Expo Ops; sign-off required before early freight window.
5) Print timeline: BrightPrints to hold soft print until 11/05 18:00 PST; after that they can produce.
